title: Help
nothing: No answer found. Try other words.

q.wallet: Can I add my card to my phone?
q.balance: Where can I see my points?
q.level: How do I reach the next level?
q.ends: What happens when my membership ends?
q.spend: How do I use my points?
q.benefits: What does my level give me?
q.sign_up: How do I join an event?
q.door: What do I show at the door?
q.details: How do I change my name, phone or language?
q.messages: How do I choose which messages I get?
q.password: What if I forget my password?
q.install: Can I keep the portal on my home screen?
q.delete: How do I delete my account?

a.card: On Home. Show its QR code at the desk, or give your member number.
a.wallet: Where the venue offers it: tap “Add to Apple Wallet” or “Add to Google Wallet” under your card.
a.earn: Show your card when you visit or pay. Points for a booking arrive once it is completed.
a.balance: Your balance is on Home. Activity lists every change.
a.level: Home shows how much more you need. Each level has its own benefits.
a.ends: You can still sign in and see everything. Ask the team to renew it.
a.spend: Choose a reward in Rewards → Catalogue. You get a code to show at the desk.
a.benefits: See Rewards → Benefits. Some apply on their own; for others, tap “Request this”.
a.offers: Extras for members. You find them in Rewards → Offers.
a.book: Tap Book, choose what and when, then confirm.
a.cancel: Open it in Bookings: “Cancel booking” is there while free cancellation lasts, and online payments go back the way you paid. Later, contact the team.
a.change: Contact the team. While free cancellation lasts, you can also cancel and book again.
a.sign_up: Open Events and tap “Sign up”. You can cancel your sign-up there too.
a.door: Your card on Home: the team scans its QR code.
a.details: In Profile. To change your email, ask the team.
a.messages: In Profile, under “What we tell you about”. A kind you switch off is not sent at all.
a.password: Sign out, then tap “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.
a.install: Yes. On an iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen. On Android: the browser menu → Add to Home screen.
a.delete: In Profile: “Delete account”, at the bottom.
